hint.monthly: A twelfth of the yearly entitlement is booked at the end of each month.
hint.annual_grant: The whole yearly entitlement is booked at the start of the year.
hint.none: Nothing is booked automatically; HR records any balance by hand.

balances.empty: No leave type applies yet. HR sets up types and the policies that give them.
balances.maxNegative: May go up to {n} below zero

request.halfDayHint: A half day is for a single day.
request.attachmentHint: Some leave types need a supporting document. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
request.attachmentRequired: This leave type needs an attachment.

quote.title: This request takes {amount}
quote.failed: This request cannot be made as it stands.

detail.title: Leave request
detail.attachmentWhere: The attachment is kept in the employee's documents.
detail.cancelConfirm: Cancel {name}'s leave ({dates})? A pending request is withdrawn; an approved one gives its days back to the balance. Leave that has already started cannot be cancelled.

adjust.title: Adjust balance

kindHint.opening: The balance the employee started with in the system.
kindHint.encashment: Days paid out instead of taken; always taken out of the balance.

adjust.nonZero: Enter an amount other than zero.
adjust.periodYearHint: The year of the effective date

requests.description: Every leave request, newest first. Approvals happen through each request's approval flow; here you read them and, with the permission, cancel one.

calendar.description: Who is away, or asking to be, in the month.

settings.description: Leave types, the policies that give them, public holidays and the minimum staffing checked before a leave is approved.

types.description: A type counted in days or hours, paid or not, against a balance or not. A type with requests, balances or policies cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
types.name: Name
types.countsCalendarDays: Counts calendar days (holidays and rest days too)
types.hideReason: Show to managers as plain leave
types.deleteWarning: A type with requests, balances or policies cannot be deleted.

policies.description: What each type gives, to whom and from when. An employee gets a type when a policy in effect covers their contract type, grade and unit.
policies.empty: No policy yet: nobody earns leave against a balance until one gives it.
policies.maxNegativeHint: 0 keeps the balance from going negative.
policies.serviceTiersHint: From a number of years of service, a different yearly entitlement.
policies.tierIncomplete: Fill in both numbers of every service tier.
policies.tierDuplicate: Two tiers start at the same number of years.
policies.carryOverMaxHint: Empty carries everything into next year.
policies.carryOverExpiryHint: Empty: carried days do not expire.
policies.appliesToHint: Leave a list empty to cover everyone on it.
policies.deleteConfirm: Delete this policy? Days already earned stay in the balances; nothing more is earned from it.

holidays.description: Public holidays are not counted as leave days. A holiday spans 31 days at most; a recurring one comes back each year. Leave already approved keeps the days it was counted with.
holidays.name: Name

coverage.description: The fewest people of a unit, or holding a position, who must be at work. A leave that would go below it is refused at approval.

me.description: Your leave: what you have, what you asked for, and every movement on your balances.
me.noRequests: You have not asked for leave yet.
me.teamEmpty: None of your direct reports is away this month.
me.cancelApproved: Cancel your approved leave for {dates}? Its days go back to your balance.
